records.name: result
records.description: What a probe or a read concluded: the availability opnview records for the provider. Every function returns one, under the key `result`.

fields.name: state
fields.description: The availability state the firewall's answer implies; absent only beside an error raised before any answer was read.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Why, as one of the closed outcome codes of docs/data-model.md, `source_availability`; absent only beside an error, as state is.

fields.name: probe
fields.description: The name of the declared endpoint whose answer decided it.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: What happened, in words, for a person reading the availability.

fields.name: separable
fields.description: Whether the firewall's own configuration marks this implementation as the one serving clients; the probe round activates only a separable one.
